'''Sebla Sarobia''' was a [[human]] who attended the [[Aki-Aki]] [[Festival of the Ancestors]] in the [[Forbidden Valley]] of the [[planet]] [[Pasaana]]<ref name="TROS VD" /> in [[35 ABY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|IX}} to [[35 ABY]].</ref> They danced with a group of humans while the [[hermit]] [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] led several [[Resistance]] agents through the festival to safety after the agents were spotted by the [[First Order]].<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref>

While at the festival, Sarobia wore [[Color|green]] and blue [[robe]]s with various jewelry, including a golden [[necklace]] and a silver piece that concealed a [[Holocamera|holocam]] for personal protection. They kept their [[Currency|money]] in a purse on a green and gold [[belt]] buckle. A green veil protected their black [[hair]], which they wore in an elaborate [[Antarian coiffure]]. Sarobia had tan skin and brown [[eye]]s.<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sebla Sarobia was created for the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']],<ref name="TROS" /> and was simultaneously identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="TROS VD" />
